intro.text: A wealthy client of the First Central Bank in Elendel, with a spotless record of repaying what he borrows.

items.text: Around 311 PC, Wax's uncle Edwarn took twelve-year-old Wax to the First Central Bank to show him how lending worked. They watched Nikolin, tall and well kept, ask for money to buy a new boat, irritated that he had to come himself instead of sending a steward. Edwarn explained that most banks would lend only to men like Nikolin, while his own also lent to poorer, riskier borrowers on punishing terms.
